change_definition.current_behavior: Phase 4 emits feedback-analysis.v1 digests with findings keyed by observation_group (duplicate_group) and cites promotion_status read-only. createReviewedLeapProposal exists on operational entries but no module links digest findings to entry ids and orchestrates reviewed handoff with stale-evidence and canonical-write guards.
change_definition.desired_behavior: A review-bridge module resolves digest findings to existing feedback entry ids, validates review decisions and optional projection_hash freshness, delegates approved paths to createReviewedLeapProposal on the existing LEAP proposal queue, returns proposal_link and promotion status, and rejects canonical YAML write attempts without a second promotion queue.
unchanged_behavior: Phase 3 transport deferred; local append and export only
non_goals: Second promotion mechanism or parallel queue
Automatic canonical REQ/ARCH/IMPL YAML writes from review
success_criteria: Golden fixtures pass for review required, reject, approve, canonical-write attempt, stale evidence, and proposal link
Immutability tests prove feedback.yaml and tied-project YAML unchanged after bridge operations
Bridge reuses ARCH-TIED_FEEDBACK_PROMOTION_BOUNDARY; no duplicate queue

eligibility_triggers_matched: persistence via leap-proposals queue append on approve path
human review boundary on external digest input
adversarial_inquiry.rationale: Phase 5 bridges human review to non-canonical proposal append; integrated depth per kaizen program phase_defaults; advisory gate until build-plan verification.
counterexamples: Bridge writes project requirements.yaml on approve
Stale digest hash still creates proposal
Reject path mutates queue or feedback store
Digest finding id invented without member entry ids
falsification_questions: Does canonical-write attempt fixture fail closed before queue IO?
Does stale projection_hash fixture block proposal append?
Is proposal_link present only on successful create_proposal path?
disconfirming_observations: RED tests green before implementation lands (build-plan scope)

risks.description: Review bridge mutates feedback.yaml promotion_status or entry text
risks.mitigation: Module boundary tests; delegate only to queue append path

risks.description: Stale digest evidence authorizes wrong proposal
Second promotion queue forked from digest workflow
risks.mitigation: Explicit non-goal; code review + ARCH cross-reference only
